FIRST AMENDMENT
to Lease Agreement
by and between
Zaheer IqbaI ("Landlord") and Zameen Developments (Private) Limited
("Tenant")
[Each a 'Party" and, collectively "Parties"]
This first amendment ("First Amendment') to the Lease Agreement dated 16 June 2023
('Agreement'), is made and entered into at Lahore on this 1 June, 2024.
WHEREAS
(A)

The Parties entered into the Agreement wherein the Landlord granted on lease, and the
Tenant took on lease from the Landlord, the entire Ground, First and Second floors of
the House No. 40-D, Nadar House, Lane 5, Adyala Road, New Lalazar, Rawalpindi
('Demised Premises"); and

(B)

The Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Agreement as per the
terms and conditions of this First Amendment.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The First Amendment shall be effective from 17 June 2024 ('Effective Date").

2.

Pursuant to Clause 2.1 of the Agreement, the Term of the Lease Agreement is hereby
extended for a period of one (1) year and thirteen (13) days, commencing from the Effective
Date and ending on 30 June 2025 ("Term").

3.

The Parties agree that, with effect from 1 July 2024, the Monthly Rent of the Demised
Premises will be increased by ten percent (10%). Accordingly, the rent payable by the
Tenant to the Landlord from 1 July 2024 shall be Rs. 49,500 (Rupees Forty-Nine Thousand
Five Hundred) per month exclusive of tax ("Monthly Rent").

4.

The Parties agree that Clause 4.3 of the Agreement stand repealed with effect from 17 May
2024.

5.

The First Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement.

6.

All other terms and provisions in the Agreement shall mutatis mutandis apply and shall
continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event
of any conflict, the terms of this First Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting term in
the Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.

7.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Agreement shall bear the same meaning
in this First Amendment, unless otherwise specified herein.

8.

The First Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall
constitute one and the same amendment.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this First Amendment, having fully
understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses.
